'''Adalbert''' is a male NPC who can be found praying to the [[Sentinel]] statue underneath the [[Cathedral of Mercury]] in {{Location|Ragunna City}} during the day.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Adalbert:''' O dear Sentinel, please calm the furious sea and guide us safely home...

==Dialogue==
;(First interaction)
:'''Alberto:'''{{sic}} O dear Sentinel, please calm the furious sea and guide us safely home...
:{{DIcon}}: Dear Sentinel...
::'''Alberto:''' It seems this is your first time performing the Tide Prayer Rite. I can tell from your slightly awkward movements and the look of uncertainty on your face.
:{{DIcon}}: What can be sought from the Sentinel?
::'''Alberto:''' This is Ragunna's famous Tide Prayer Rite. Sailors pray here for calm seas before long voyage.
:'''Alberto:''' Legend has it, that the Sentinel has calmed countless storms, saved lives at sea, and guided people out of the worldly ocean...
:'''Alberto:''' Hey! Come on! Let me teach you a trick! When a storm looms, hold a sword or dagger to your chest, then make a motion as if cleaving the storm in two...
:{{DIcon}}: Can I summon the Sentinel like this?
::'''Alberto:''' Of course not. This gesture is to invoke the Sentinel's power, helping us through the storm, and conquering the sea!
:{{DIcon}}: Is this how I can ensure a more dignified sea burial?
::'''Alberto:''' Ah, don't be so pessimistic. The sea isn't untamable{{sic}}! This gesture is to invoke the Sentinel's power, helping us through the storm, and conquering the sea!
:'''Alberto:''' You're from a foreign land, so you might not fully understand...
:'''Alberto:''' This simple gesture, however, can fill us with resolve and strength when facing the raging tides.
:'''Alberto:''' In my view, this is the essence of faith.
----
;(Second interaction)
:'''Alberto:''' When a storm approaches, remember to raise your sword. Hold it to your chest, then make a motion as if cleaving the storm...
:'''Alberto:''' That simple gesture fills us with resolve and strength when facing the madness of the tides.
----
{{Spoiler}}
;(First interaction after {{Quest|Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides}}
:'''Adalbert:''' O dear Sentinel, please calm the furious sea and guide us safely home...
:{{DIcon}} You're still saying that?
:'''Adalbert:''' Haha, and why shouldn't I?
:'''Adalbert:''' Only a rare few ever meet the Sentinel in person. Even if most of us never catch so much as a glimpse, we still live beneath Their blessings.
:{{DIcon}} The Sentinel isn't coming back.
::'''Adalbert:''' The Sentinel may be gone, but for a being so noble, Their return not impossible. {{sic}}
:{{DIcon}} You sound so sure about it.
::'''Adalbert:''' Of course I'm sure! And when They return, perhaps They'll see our devotion and appear upon the sea.
:'''Adalbert:''' But even if the Sentinel never comes back... our resolve and strength must be enough to cleave through the raging tides and carry us to victory, again and again!
----
;(Talk again)
:'''Adalbert:''' When a storm approaches, remember to raise your sword. Hold it to your chest, then make a motion as if cleaving the storm...
:'''Adalbert:''' That simple gesture fills us with resolve and strength when facing the madness of the tides.
:'''Adalbert:''' In my view, this is the essence of faith.
{{Dialogue End}}
